fix.summary: The plan is not construction-ready. It omits both required behavior oracles and narrows the accepted authority. Amend it with: (1) Behavior covering every cross-leg case—not only a destination leg with no local request/recovery evidence—so evidence owned by leg A cannot enter leg B’s terminal report even when B has its own local evidence; (2) an explicit Red counterexample at the production `buildCollectorReceipt` attempt-to-leg join, using at least two configured legs and leg-A request/recovery proof, that identifies the currently failing observable (leg B’s terminal-report evidence references or their resolved/transitive evidence closure contain leg-A proof); and (3) an explicit Green oracle that leg B’s terminal report contains only evidence admissible for B, excludes leg A’s request comment/attempt and recovery snapshot proof both directly and through referenced snapshots, while leg A retains its own proof and the frozen envelope, markers, and statuses remain unchanged. The stated owner and scope are adequate; helper names, fixture shapes, and library details may remain Apply decisions.
